metadata.name: First Item Empty State – Empty List that Turns into Your First Row
metadata.description: First Item Empty State for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): an empty list whose placeholder rows become the first real row on Create. It is built to make the moment after Create feel continuous: the row lifts out of the ghost layer, the title types in, the pill lands, the copy folds into a toolbar and the rest collapse. onCreate returns an item or a promise; a rejection shows Try again. Controlled or uncontrolled items, renderItem, keyboard support, a live region, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for the first screen of projects, clients or files. The included demo creates two projects, fails once and retries, and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy
